title: Belle La Mer | KEY.co
description_expanded: The outdoor experience rivals a private resort, centered around a 35-foot saltwater pool with a sun deck surrounded by inviting seating. A cabana-style indoor/outdoor living space features a kitchen, large TV with sound system, and soaring ceilings, creating the perfect atmosphere for poolside dining or game-day gatherings. A bocce ball court, ping pong, corn hole, fire pit, and grilling station add even more opportunities for entertainment and relaxation. Spacious king suites with private bathrooms, a versatile bunk room, and multiple living areas comfortably accommodate large groups. With six adult bikes, a six-seater golf cart, and easy access to nearby Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and 30Avenue, this remarkable Inlet Beach home offers an unforgettable coastal escape where relaxation and recreation come together effortlessly. Perched in the charming coastal community of Inlet Beach, this expansive gated retreat offers breathtaking Gulf views and effortless access to one of the most beautiful stretches of shoreline along 30A. Just a one-minute, stair-free walk from the sugar-white sand, the home is thoughtfully designed for gatherings, blending spacious interiors with exceptional outdoor living. Floor-to-ceiling sliding doors frame panoramic Gulf vistas from the main living level, where a chef-inspired kitchen, generous dining areas, and comfortable lounge spaces create the perfect setting for shared meals and memorable evenings. With an elevator connecting all three stories and multiple balconies overlooking the water, every level offers a relaxing place to enjoy coastal breezes and stunning sunsets.
